title: Aureline M5 supported-line follow-up closure
description: Canonical per-domain follow-up-closure record minted by the ORR-history-event and follow-up-closure lane over the frozen M5 supported-line-transparency matrix. Turns a change in an active supported line's follow-up state into a visible, machine-checkable closure event against its archived ORR history instead of a shiproom note or oral memory: it records the closure-drift scope the change sits in — an unclosed action item (a post-review follow-up action is still unclosed on the active line rather than only in an archived meeting packet), stale rehearsal evidence (the line's rehearsal evidence has gone stale versus its archived ORR history), or an unreconstructable line history (the current supported line can no longer be reconstructed from ORR history without separate shiproom notes or oral memory). Names the closure scope, binds the resolved supported-line identity, the affected history-entry reference, the archived-versus-active-line reference, and the active closure reason so support, partner, procurement, and governance surfaces see unclosed follow-up work or stale rehearsal evidence on the active line, and can keep promotion, support, and postmortem work from depending on shiproom folklore. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's ORR history by hand. Public-safe and internal-only variants share one canonical record identity; raw secret values, private endpoints, and privileged incident / security internals never cross this boundary.
